launch_tag_note: The launch set is the prompt table minus the deferred prompt(s). It is committed BEFORE the launch; the driver reads it from the launch checkout.

deferred.reason: the STINGAllo question for 1T4J chain A: the service returns a non-empty prediction only for 1T4J chain A and 5EHR chain A, and 5EHR is already the subject of K03, so the question would duplicate K02; the prompt keeps its committed criteria and is not run
deferred.replacement_prompt: Build a residue contact network for KRAS in PDB entry 6OIM chain A. Find the shortest path between a residue within 4 angstroms of the covalent inhibitor and a residue within 4 angstroms of GDP. Report both residues, the path, its length and the cutoff used.
deferred.replacement_status: written and validated on 2026-11-03 from the primary sources, committed before its runs, and run as a separate batch of 3 repeats x 2 arms
deferred.criteria_note: The criteria of the deferred question stay in benchmark/checklists.json unchanged: the prompt is deferred, not rewritten.
deferred.deferred_note: Dated note 2026-11-03: the deferred question keeps its committed criteria under the reserved id K04D (its id K04 was taken by the replacement, which was validated and run as a separate batch).

dated_notes: Dated note 2026-10-28: the launch set is committed BEFORE the launch and the driver refuses to start without it. The prompt table itself (40 prompts, K04 included) is unchanged: a deferred prompt keeps its committed criteria.

Dated note 2026-11-03: K04 is no longer deferred. The replacement the launch set named on 2026-10-28 (the residue contact network of KRAS in 6OIM chain A and the shortest path between a residue within 4 A of the covalent inhibitor and a residue within 4 A of GDP) was validated from the primary sources, its checklist was committed before its runs, and its six runs (3 repeats x 2 arms) were made as a separate batch under their own launch tag. The deferred question keeps its committed criteria under the reserved id K04D. The 39 prompts of the main run and its 234 runs are unchanged.
